msgs.what: Same answer as the normal path.
The analysis itself succeeds and reaches the dashboard as today.
Wrapped in `retry_transient` and a 20 s timeout (`ACTION_TIMEOUT_S`).
A transient error is retried once; a timeout or a final error gives up.
Every peer node catches everything, logs `peer_action_failed action=suggest_probe`, and returns an empty update. The run finishes normally; the follow-up is simply missing.
